resources.string: I picked these from what happened. Tap another if I guessed wrong.
Robot\'s version, the phone, its chip, the model and the look. Unticked, only the version and language go.

Long numbers, the numbers of your contacts and People, dates with their month and times said in words go as [number], emails and addresses (your contacts\' too) as [address], and the names of your contacts and People as [name], as shown above. Places, and what I read from your other apps, go as shown. Your words below go as they are.

Long numbers, People\'s numbers, dates with their month and times said in words go as [number], emails and addresses as [address], and the names in People as [name], as shown above. Names, short numbers and addresses that are only in your contacts aren\'t hidden, because I can\'t read your contacts: check with Show before you send. Places, and what I read from your other apps, go as shown. Your words below go as they are.

Long numbers, your contacts\' numbers, dates with their month and times said in words go as [number], emails and addresses (your contacts\' too) as [address], and the names of your contacts as [name], as shown above. Names and short numbers that are only in People aren\'t hidden, because I can\'t read People: check with Show before you send. Places, and what I read from your other apps, go as shown. Your words below go as they are.

Long numbers, dates with their month and times said in words go as [number], emails and addresses as [address], as shown above. The names and short numbers in your contacts and People, and your contacts\' addresses, aren\'t hidden, because I can\'t read your contacts or People: check with Show before you send. Places, and what I read from your other apps, go as shown. Your words below go as they are.

Long numbers, the numbers of your contacts and People, dates with their month and times said in words go as [number], emails and addresses (your contacts\' too) as [address], and the names of your contacts and People as [name], as shown above. I can\'t read some of People, so names and short numbers only there aren\'t hidden: check with Show before you send. Places, and what I read from your other apps, go as shown. Your words below go as they are.

Long numbers, People\'s numbers, dates with their month and times said in words go as [number], emails and addresses as [address], and the names in People as [name], as shown above. Names, short numbers and addresses that are only in your contacts, and names and short numbers only in some of People, aren\'t hidden, because I can\'t read your contacts or some of People: check with Show before you send. Places, and what I read from your other apps, go as shown. Your words below go as they are.

Each report\'s reference, to quote it

Each report you handed to an app with Send: its reference, so you can quote it, when you handed it on, its kind and the parts ticked. Never what it said. The last 50 stay on this phone, not in a backup.
